text: dsh-task-notify 是 DSH Web 通知插件，在会话栏提供设置面板。主回合、子代理和工作流结束，以及审批、用户提问、待确认计划或目标受阻时，它可发送 Windows 桌面通知，并可选用 PushPlus 推送手机。用户能调整通知类别、测试通道和切换中英文。适合需要及时获知任务进度或待处理请求的 DSH Web 用户；桌面提醒需要 Windows 与 PowerShell，手机推送需配置 PushPlus Token。

dsh-task-notify alerts DSH Web users when tasks finish or need attention, including approvals, questions, plans, and blocked goals. It sends Windows notifications and optional PushPlus phone alerts. Its panel toggles alert types. Desktop alerts need Windows; phone alerts need a PushPlus token.
想让 DSH 任务结束时弹出 Windows 通知。
我希望 agent 需要审批或回答时能马上提醒我。
有没有办法收到子代理和工作流结束的提醒？
想把 DSH 的任务通知推送到手机。
Notify me when a DSH agent finishes or needs my approval.
I want Windows alerts for completed subagents and workflows.
Can I get optional phone notifications when my DSH work needs attention?
dsh-task-notify 的功能「任务与等待事项通知」：主回合、子代理或工作流结束，以及审批、用户问题、计划评审和目标阻塞时生成通知，按类别开关控制。
dsh-task-notify 的功能「Windows 桌面提醒」：使用 PowerShell 与 BurntToast 显示系统 toast；代码包含缺少模块时的当前用户安装流程，并使用包内图标。
dsh-task-notify 的功能「PushPlus 手机推送」：配置 Token 并启用推送后，插件向 PushPlus send 接口提交通知标题与正文；面板提供测试推送。
dsh-task-notify 的功能「通知设置面板」：点击会话标题栏铃铛打开面板，可切换总开关、分类开关、语言并测试 Windows 通知或 PushPlus 通道。
dsh-task-notify 的 Windows toast 依赖 Windows PowerShell 环境与 BurntToast；插件在检测到模块缺失时会尝试为当前用户安装。
dsh-task-notify 的可选手机推送会将通知标题和正文通过 POST 发送至 www.pushplus.plus；使用此通道需提供 PushPlus Token。
DSH 老是停下来等我确认，有没有及时提醒的办法？

dsh-task-notify README · dsh-task-notify：[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

**Agent 停下来的那一刻，让 Windows 通知你。**

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 插件：主回合 / 子代理 / 工作流任务完成时，以及 **agent 停下来等你操作时**
（需要审批、向你提问、计划待确认、目标受阻），弹出真正的 **Windows 系统通知**（带系统提示音与
DeepSeek 图标），可选 PushPlus 微信推送——浏览器关闭也能收到。

*桌面通道实拍：标题 + 会话名 / 时间 / 状态，带 DeepSeek 图标与系统提示音。*

dsh-task-notify README · 特性：| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 🔔 **系统级通知** | 经 BurntToast（PowerShell 模块）调用 Windows 通知中心，播放系统提示音，无需网页授权 |
| 📦 **依赖免装** | BurntToast 缺失时插件**自动安装**（当前用户范围，免管理员）；已装机器上零打扰 |
| 🌐 **中英双语** | 面板头部滑块热切换，通知与面板文案即时切换；语言跟随 DSH 的「设置 → 通用 → 语言」，默认中文 |
| 🖼️ **图标热更新** | 图标取自包内 `deepseek.png`（按内容指纹缓存），替换后**下一条通知立即换新**，无需重建或重启 |
| 📱 **手机推送** | 可选 PushPlus 推送，电脑不在身边也能收到 |
| ⏸️ **等你操作就提醒** | 审批请求、agent 提问、计划待确认、目标受阻——agent 停下的每一类场景都有独立通知 |
| 🎛️ **即改即存** | 总开关 + 7 个分类开关，改动立即落盘到 DSH settings，重启不丢 |
| 📐 **布局自适应** | 配置面板逐帧跟随 dsh-better-sidebar 的右侧 / 底部面板让位，不遮挡 |

dsh-task-notify README · 通知一览：| 通知 | 触发时机 |
| --- | --- |
| **Agent任务完成** | 主回合 / 子代理 / 工作流结束 |
| **需要你的审批** | agent 权限不足发起提权、越权执行审批（审批策略 `ask`） |
| **Agent 正在问你** | agent 调用 `ask_user_question` 主动停下咨询 |
| **计划待你确认** | `/plan` 后 agent 调用 `exit_plan_mode` 提交计划、等待确认 |
| **目标受阻** | goal 自动回合因持续阻塞而停止 |

每条通知携带会话名（沿父链回溯到根会话）、时间与状态（完成 / 失败 / 中止 / 阻塞…）。
完整的触发条件、内容格式与状态文案见 [通知类型与触发时机](docs/notifications.md)。

dsh-task-notify README · 快速开始：1. **装依赖**——Windows 10 / 11。BurntToast 已由插件**自动安装**（当前用户范围，免管理员）；
   如需手工安装：

```powershell
   Install-Module BurntToast -Scope CurrentUser
   ```

2. **装插件**——DSH ≥ 0.1.6-alpha.1，安装后自动 reconcile `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/V-Reason/dsh-task-notify.git
   ```

3. **验证**——重启 DSH，点击会话标题栏铃铛 →「通知类型」层 →「测试 Windows 通知」，
   应听到系统提示音并弹出带 DeepSeek 图标的 toast。

dsh-task-notify README · 快速开始：4. **切语言**（可选）——面板头部滑块在「中文 / English」之间热切换，通知与面板文案即时生效；
   它写的就是 DSH 自己的语言偏好，与「设置 → 通用 → 语言」同步。

手机推送（可选）：在 https://www.pushplus.plus 扫码取「一对一推送」token → 展开「手机推送」层粘贴并
保存 → 点「测试手机推送」。

> 本地 `file:` 安装、升级方式与故障排查见 [安装与升级](docs/installation.md)；
> 面板交互与全部设置项见 [配置与使用](docs/configuration.md)。
> 升级 DSH 后插件失效时，先跑一次 `npm run verify` 定位平台契约变更；
> 排查方法与通用套路见 [DSH 升级后插件失效的排查手册](docs/troubleshooting.md)。

dsh-task-notify README · dsh-task-notify：[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

**The moment your agent stops, Windows tells you.**

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web plugin: when a main turn, subagent or workflow finishes — and whenever
the **agent pauses for you** (approval needed, a question for you, a plan awaiting review, a blocked
goal) — it raises a real **Windows system notification** (with the system sound and the DeepSeek
icon), plus optional PushPlus push to your phone, so you hear about it even with the browser closed.
dsh-task-notify README · dsh-task-notify：*The desktop channel in the wild: title + session name / time / status, with the DeepSeek icon and the system sound.*

dsh-task-notify README · Features：| Capability | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| 🔔 **System-level notifications** | Windows notifications through BurntToast (a PowerShell module), with the system sound and no web permission prompt |
| 📦 **No dependency setup** | The plugin **installs BurntToast itself** when missing (current-user scope, no admin); a machine that already has it sees no change at all |
| 🌐 **Chinese + English** | A slider in the panel header switches the notification and panel copy live; the language follows DSH's own *Settings → General → Language* and defaults to Chinese |
| 🖼️ **Hot-swappable icon** | The icon is `deepseek.png` inside the package (content-fingerprint cached): replace it and the **next notification uses the new one**, no rebuild or restart |
| 📱 **Phone push** | Optional PushPlus push, for when you are away from the machine |
| ⏸️ **Speaks up when you are the blocker** | Approvals, agent questions, plan reviews and blocked goals each get their own notification |
| 🎛️ **Saved as you click** | One master switch plus seven per-kind switches, written to DSH settings immediately and kept across restarts |

dsh-task-notify README · What you get notified about：| Notification | Raised when |
| --- | --- |
| **Agent task finished** | A main turn / subagent / workflow ends |
| **Approval needed** | The agent lacks permission and asks for elevation (approval policy `ask`) |
| **Agent is asking you** | The agent calls `ask_user_question` and stops to consult you |
| **Plan waiting for review** | After `/plan`, the agent calls `exit_plan_mode` and waits for your decision |
| **Goal blocked** | An autonomous goal run stops on a persistent blocker |

dsh-task-notify README · What you get notified about：Every notification carries the session name (walked up the parent chain to the root conversation),
the timestamp and the status (Completed / Failed / Aborted / Blocked …). The full trigger conditions,
payload format and status vocabulary are documented in [docs/notifications.md](docs/notifications.md)
(Chinese).

dsh-task-notify README · Quick start：1. **Prerequisites** — Windows 10 / 11. BurntToast is **installed automatically** by the plugin
   (current-user scope, no admin). To install it by hand:

```powershell
   Install-Module BurntToast -Scope CurrentUser
   ```

2. **Install the plugin** — DSH ≥ 0.1.6-alpha.1; `dsh.profile.bundles` is reconciled on install:

```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/V-Reason/dsh-task-notify.git
   ```

dsh-task-notify README · Quick start：3. **Verify** — restart DSH, click the bell in the session header → expand **Notification types** →
   **Test Windows notification**: you should hear the system sound and see a toast with the DeepSeek
   icon.

4. **Switch language** (optional) — the slider in the panel header flips between 中文 and English
   with immediate effect on both notifications and the panel. It writes DSH's own language
   preference, so it stays in sync with *Settings → General → Language*.

dsh-task-notify README · Quick start：Phone push (optional): scan the QR code at https://www.pushplus.plus to get your one-to-one token →
expand the **Phone push** group, paste it and save → click **Test phone push**.
